description.en: PixKit 是一套像素画风格的 UI 组件库，同时供 React 与 React Native 用，仓库是 monorepo，拆成 @pixkit/react、@pixkit/native、@pixkit/tokens 三个包，另有一个网页版 Live Demo。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by shayaqhmetov/pixkit (https://github.com/shayaqhmetov/pixkit).
Technology stack: react, react-native, typescript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: README 第一行是 PixKit 🎮，接着一句 A pixel-art themed UI component library for React and React Native, built with TypeScript and modern design tokens。小节按 🌐 Live Demo（https://shayaqhmetov.github.io/pixkit/）、📦 Packages、🚀 Installation、📖 Usage、🎨 Components、🛠️ Development、📝 License 排开，Packages 一段说明 @pixkit/react 带网页 CSS、@pixkit/native 是 React Native 组件、@pixkit/tokens 放颜色与间距这些 token。仓库根目录是 pnpm-workspace.yaml、turbo.json、.changeset 那套 monorepo 结构，packages 的提交信息写着 add canonical qurbaqa theme tokens and themed native kit，Contributors 三人里除了作者还有一个 claude。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
